name: Braised Tender Beef Short Rib with Creamy Polenta
whyItWorks: Slow braising breaks beef short rib connective fibers until it falls apart on the fork without effort. The smooth polenta provides gentle starch without skin or seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trim any visible ribbon of soft fat from the meat before eating. Ask for polenta made with light butter if lactose sensitive.
